This week, I met with representatives of @KentuckyBev.

We discussed supporting Kentucky’s beverage industry and the thousands of Kentuckians who produce, market, and distribute non-alcoholic beverages across the Commonwealth.

✅ 1/20/25 Republicans took control of White House + Senate + House.

❌They expanded spending beyond Biden’s budget, causing U.S. debt to increase $2.7 trillion since then.

👎I voted against this excessive spending and that’s why the swamp wants me gone.

👍I keep my promises!

I've introduced HR 8470, the Surveillance Accountability Act, with @RepBoebert.

It requires a probable cause warrant before the federal government can search your private data — even if that data is held by a third party.

Warrantless searches are unconstitutional.

This week, I met with @TXGunRights President Chris McNutt, Chief Firearms Instructor & Director of Partnerships Kyle Rittenhouse and his wife Bella, and Board of Directors member Michael Flusche.

Thanks for all you do to educate people about firearms & to protect our 2A rights!
Tune in at 10:30 AM to watch the live stream of my press conference with @RepBoebert. We will be discussing our introduction of the Surveillance Accountability Act. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1kJzDMWzr…

Today at 10:30am ET, @RepBoebert and I will host a press conference at the Capitol House Triangle to announce our new Surveillance Accountability Act.

It requires government searches to be conducted with a warrant based on probable cause, in accordance with the 4th Amendment.

Today, I met with members of @SMART_LU110, which represents sheet metal workers over most of the 4th District.

We discussed their work across a wide range of industries, including HVAC, health care, and Kentucky's distilleries.

Thanks for coming by!

The GOP is soon going to wish they hadn’t wasted all that donor money in an effort to shrink the tent.
thehill.com/homenews/house/5…

I had a great meeting with the Kentucky Trucking Association.

We discussed surface reauthorization priorities and challenges affecting truckers, such as staged accidents and “chameleon carrier” companies that pose safety risks.

Thank you, truckers, for keeping America moving!

I'm a cosponsor of the Dismantle DEI Act of 2025.

HR 925, @RepMichaelCloud's bill, would eliminate federal funding for DEl offices and programs, rescind related executive orders, and establish a private right of action for individuals to sue over violations of its provisions.

What a nice surprise! @universityofky Gov Relations Director Lily Douthitt brought me a bottle of KY Wildcask Bourbon from the James B. Beam Institute for Kentucky Spirits.

The Institute is based on the UK campus, and students help make Wildcask Bourbon.

Thanks, @beam_uky!

There are 3 locks and dams and 267 miles of the Ohio River in Kentucky’s 4th District.

Today, I met with members of the Passenger Vessel Association. We discussed ferry line maintenance, which is critical to both interstate commerce and local residents’ daily lives.

Today, I met with KY members of @NBWA, the National Beer Wholesalers Association.

We discussed reversing legislative setbacks on hemp that could affect production of hemp-derived beverages.

When I was a kid, I worked in the Vanceburg beer distributorship my grandfather started.

No one should have to beg the government to exercise a constitutionally protected right anywhere in the country.

Thank you @RepTrentKelly for cosponsoring HR 645, the National Constitutional Carry Act.

As your United States Representative, I have the privilege of nominating a limited number of qualified candidates to attend one of the U.S. Service Academies. On Saturday, approximately 100 students and their parents attended my annual U.S. Service Academy Day.

No one should have to beg the government to exercise a constitutionally protected right anywhere in the country. 

Thank you @RepDavid for cosponsoring HR 645, the National Constitutional Carry Act.
Deadline to register online is 4pm local time.
